aurora/docs/operations.md:
# Aurora operations

## Delivery attempts
The default retry.attempts value is 5 total delivery attempts, including the first attempt.
The setting is a count, not a delay in seconds.

## Payload recording
Set capture.payload=false to stop recording payload bodies on a test relay.
Envelope identifiers and delivery outcomes remain recorded when capture is off.
Environment permissions in the production policy still apply.

## Restore sequence
Run aurora restore SNAPSHOT_ID to load a snapshot.
After loading succeeds, run aurora journal replay before reopening ingress.
The production policy defines checks required before loading the snapshot.
aurora/docs/production.md:
# Aurora production policy

## Capture permission
Production relays must retain payload recording; capture.payload=false is forbidden in production.
Only isolated test relays may disable payload recording.

## Recovery prerequisites
Before restoring a production snapshot, pause ingress so new messages cannot arrive.
Before restoring, verify that the retained journal watermark is at least the snapshot marker.
If the watermark is older, obtain the missing journal range before restoring.

## Incident exports
Support exports must not include raw customer payloads.
Redacting an export does not disable recording inside the running relay.
rivet/docs/cache.md:
# Rivet runner cache

## Remote access
Set cache.remote.url to the shared-cache endpoint.
Supply a credential scoped to the selected cache namespace; a credential for a different namespace is rejected.
Network reachability alone is not namespace authorization.

## Build flags
rivet build --fresh skips cache reads but still writes new successful build artifacts to the cache.
rivet build --no-cache disables both cache reads and cache writes for that invocation.

## Private networks
Every artifact read from a shared cache must have its signature verified, including on a private network.
rivet/docs/security.md:
# Rivet security policy

## Authenticity
Every shared-cache artifact requires signature verification.
A private network does not exempt the runner from signature verification.
An invalidly signed artifact must not be linked into a build.

## Signing secrets
Supply the signing secret from the runner secret store.
Never store the signing secret in rivet.toml, even if only its owner can read the file.

## Logs
Do not place access credentials in diagnostic logs.
rivet/docs/configuration.md:
# Rivet configuration

## Priority
For ordinary settings, the priority from highest to lowest is command line, environment, project rivet.toml, then machine defaults.
Setting priority does not override the security policy for signing secrets.

## Aliases
An alias chooses a named build target.
Aliases may not refer to themselves.
quartz/docs/v1.md:
# Quartz version 1 consistency
This page applies only to Quartz version 1.

## Object reads
After a successful write, a read of the same key may still return the previous value.

## Listings
Bucket listings are eventually consistent.
No numerical p99 response-time guarantee is specified here.
quartz/docs/v2.md:
# Quartz version 2 consistency
This page applies only to Quartz version 2.

## Object reads
After a successful write, a read of the same key returns the new value.

## Listings
Bucket listings remain eventually consistent; the object-read guarantee does not extend to listings.
No numerical p99 response-time guarantee is specified here.
quartz/docs/receipts.md:
# Quartz operational receipts

## Receipt path
The latest promotion receipt is written to state/receipts/head.json.
It contains the release identifier and the previous and new configuration digests.

## Retention
An administrator may archive receipt files.
This manual specifies no guaranteed receipt-retention duration.
